fake_tools.clip.exe:
#!/bin/sh
REC='@REC@'
n=$(/bin/cat "$REC/seq" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n+1))
echo "$n" > "$REC/seq"
mode=copy
{ printf '%s\n' 'clip.exe' "$mode" "$#"; for a in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$a"; done; } > "$REC/call.$n"
case "$mode" in
copy|type) /bin/cat > "$REC/call.$n.stdin"; exit @EXIT@ ;;
paste) /bin/cat "$REC/paste"; exit @EXIT@ ;;
focus)
  f=$(/bin/cat "$REC/focus.n" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  f=$((f+1))
  echo "$f" > "$REC/focus.n"
  if [ "$f" = 1 ]; then printf '%s\n' '@FOCUS1@'; else printf '%s\n' '@FOCUS2@'; fi
  exit @FOCUSEXIT@ ;;
esac
